text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru... Thank you for
reading my
fortune the other day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, the pleasure was mine! Did you
succeed
in obtaining the lucky item we
divined? A picture
of the full moon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After some effort, I think I finally got
one. Please
have a look.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... I've never seen such a radiant
moon!
Wait, isn't this a picture of the
sun?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It seems she did see the full moon. But
she forgot
to take a picture before bed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's right. As soon as I realized my
mistake, I
hurried to take a photograph
as quickly as I
could!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But you hurried after the moon was gone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I spotted her on my way to morning
training,
desperately pointing her
camera at the sun. It was
a surreal sight
to be sure...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe this is just me, but... I seem
to sense
an aura of great happiness
around Bright, even
though she missed
out on her lucky item.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's because of Dober's peach tea.
We
drank it together while watching the
sun rise, and
it was the most magical
experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Stop exaggerating. It's just tea—I'll make
you
some whenever you want.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, so it was the fragrance of a lucky drink! You must let me attend your next tea party!
